# GitHub Repository Information

## Repository Name
`csv-phone-validator`

## Description
Smart CSV data cleaner with Kenya phone number validation. Built with Nuxt 3, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Perfect for bulk SMS, airtime distribution, and CRM data management.
